Chapter One: Introduction

This document tests parsing and rendering of a large AsciiDoc file with many features.

Background

The parser must handle documents with hundreds of lines efficiently. This paragraph contains bold, italic, monospace, and combined formatting.

Goals

  1. Parse correctly

  2. Render identical output across TFMs

  3. Handle edge cases gracefully
